title: Better Were Wolf
description: Rediscover the joy of playing the cult classic board game "Werewolf of Thiercelieux," but this time in Minecraft!
body:
Rediscover the joy of playing the cult classic board game "Werewolf of Thiercelieux," but this time in Minecraft!

## Installation:

Install a version of Papergame 1.21.X
Download the plugin's .jar file and place it in your server's plugin folder
Start your server
Configure player spawn locations using the following commands:
addpos: Adds a spawn location for the game. Usage: /addpos [number]

delpos: Deletes a spawn location. Usage: /delpos [number]

Then, choose your game configuration with your friends!

To end a game in progress, use this command: /partyend
